name: Torture extends Transgression after spending nine Thirst stacks (#1911)
contract: Torture 504071's native effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER and already applies Vampiric Feast's 50% leech modifier. Its effect 1 has ProcFlags 0 and references helper 561152, whose native effect adds 5000 ms to Transgression 801076. Vampiric Fang ranks are handled in AscensionBloodmageSecondary.cpp and consume Thirst 706613 only after a successful hit. Verify that eight stacks are consumed without extending Transgression and nine stacks are consumed while extending it by five seconds.

steps.label: Leave enough duration to measure the eight-stack control
Transgression duration before an eight-stack Fang
Vampiric Fang consumes eight Thirst stacks
Eight stacks do not extend Transgression
Allow Vampiric Fang's category cooldown to expire
Leave enough duration to measure the nine-stack case
Transgression duration before a nine-stack Fang
Vampiric Fang consumes nine Thirst stacks
Nine stacks extend Transgression by five seconds
